Return-to-fitness stage

1 · Recover

Rest, comfort, daily care.

2 · Reconnect

Breathing, gentle mobility, easy walking.

3 · Foundation

Clinician-cleared low-load strength.

4 · Strength

Progressive home resistance.

5 · Regular fitness

Long-term personalized program.

Progression is profile-controlled and should follow clinician / physiotherapist guidance where relevant.

Mental health & safety

Safety escalation

If Varshini reports thoughts of self-harm or harming the baby, severe confusion, hallucinations, extreme agitation, or feeling unsafe, Aura should stop normal coaching and direct her to urgent professional help and a trusted person. This must not be handled only by the in-app coach.
